description: Colombo Municipal Council - Renamed Nelum Pokuna Mawatha and Nelum Pokuna Roundabout as Ananda Kumaraswamy Mawatha and Horton Roundabout
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the renaming of a road and roundabout by local government authorities. The content primarily deals with land and property matters (specifically street naming and municipal boundaries) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category. The focus is on geographical identification and municipal administration of public spaces, which falls under Land Gazettes (Type 4).
